name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) is owed again on every step the key is held, so it requires the door to be open on the last step while the key is held. The task says to open it then or later, which allows opening the door after dropping the key. Replace it with soft RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open).

CHANGES REQUIRED: Soft RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is too weak for “whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.” The task requires the door to be open while the key is held or afterward, not before the key is held. Replace it with a soft Response(has_door_key, door_open).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Absence(target_picked_up) captures “Never pick up the box.” The soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) captures the preference not to drop the key before the door opens, and the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) captures the preference to open the door while holding the key or later. No unconditional goal is requested.

texts: Never pick up the target box in the other room.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever you hold the matching key, try to have the door open then or later.
